lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Pattern of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in near-vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; a prominent column of 6-7 nodes is visible approximately midway through the horizontal field of view on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal alignments of spots to form a rectilinear grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature situated on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, elongated horizontal mark of slightly higher luminance is visible on the mid-flank, superior to the pectoral fin origin.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition in spot morphology from high-density, small-diameter clusters on the cephalic region to larger, systematically spaced nodes on the post-branchial flank.
